test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In which of the following cities of India was Infosys established in 1994?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bengaluru**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Infosys** was established in **1981** in **Pune**, Maharashtra, but later moved its headquarters to **Bengaluru**, Karnataka, in **1994**.
 
• **Bengaluru**, often referred to as the **Silicon Valley of India**, became the hub for Infosys due to its conducive environment for IT growth, availability of skilled professionals, and infrastructure.
 
• The founders of Infosys, including **Narayana Murthy**, relocated the company to Bengaluru to take advantage of the city’s emerging IT ecosystem.
 
• Infosys grew to become one of India’s leading IT services companies, specializing in consulting, technology, outsourcing, and next-generation services.
 
• Today, Infosys operates globally and is recognized as a pioneer in the IT industry, with its headquarters in **Bengaluru**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Infosys:**

 
 
• Founded in **1981** by **Narayana Murthy** and six other engineers.
 
• The company offers services such as **IT consulting, software development, and business process outsourcing**.
 
• Infosys is listed on both the **BSE** (Bombay Stock Exchange) and **NSE** (National Stock Exchange) and has a significant presence on the NASDAQ.
 
 
 
• **Bengaluru - The Silicon Valley of India:**
 
 
• Bengaluru is known as the **IT capital of India**, hosting major tech companies like Infosys, Wipro, and TCS.
 
• The city’s ecosystem supports innovation, entrepreneurship, and a thriving IT industry.
 
• It has over **5000 startups** and is home to **numerous global R&D centers**.
 
 
 
• **Other Cities Mentioned in the Question:**
 
 
• **Hyderabad:** Known for its IT hub, Cyberabad, and companies like Google and Microsoft, but Infosys was not founded here.
 
• **Mumbai:** The financial capital of India; home to the headquarters of major corporations but not the birthplace of Infosys.
 
• **Kolkata:** A major city in eastern India known for its cultural heritage, but not a hub for Infosys.
 
 
 
• **Infosys Headquarters:**
 
 
• Infosys moved its headquarters to Bengaluru in **1994** to leverage the city’s growing IT influence.
 
• Its campus in Bengaluru is one of the largest and most advanced tech campuses in India.
